title: A sandbox checkpoint
description: POST /v1/containers/{id}/checkpoints {label?} answers 201 with one; GET .../checkpoints answers {checkpoints: [...]}, newest first; POST .../checkpoints/{checkpoint}/restore answers 202 {id, status: "restoring"} and the sandbox is running again from that checkpoint, under the same id; DELETE .../checkpoints/{checkpoint} answers 204. A sandbox that is changing state answers 409 sandbox_busy.

label.description: what the client said it was for, such as the step it came before

kind.description: filesystem: the whole sandbox disk; workspace: /sandbox only

bytes.description: storage this checkpoint adds beyond the one before it

expires_at.description: when the lab removes it; absent while the sandbox is kept
